{{Quote|Captain! Show this droid what happens when you use that word|Osi Sobeck, to the droid commando captain|<ref name="citadel">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref>}}
A '''droid commando captain''' was stationed inside the Citadel under the command of [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] was being captured after being held. However, an elite team of Jedi and clone troopers infiltrated the prison and managed to liberate Even Piell. This droid along with Sobeck and a few other battle droids headed for the dungeon only to see that the naval officers along with their captain, [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] had escaped with the help of the freed Piell and the rest of the team. When a [[Unidentified BX-series droid commando (The Citadel)/Legends|droid]] entered the dungeon and reported the escape to Sobeck, Sobeck angrily told the captain to execute the commando droid to which the captain did without raising any questions.
